synopsis: Chapter 12 and the glossary identify TEMP Guidebook version 3.1 as a January 2017 publication documenting the U.S. Department of Defense requirement for a Test and Evaluation Master Plan (TEMP) for major programmes [f9546, f16407]. Both pair the guidebook with DoD Instruction 5000.89, dated November 2020 [f9546, f16407]. A separate Chapter 12 finding associates TEMP / IDSK with these same documents, but provides no further explanation of IDSK or the guidebook’s specific provisions [f10039].

relations.note: Both state the major-programme TEMP requirement and identify the same documents and dates.
Adds the major-programme requirement and publication dates to the document association.
Glossary specifies the TEMP requirement and dates behind Chapter 12’s document association.
